trace.first_pass_query:
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX dbp: <http://dbpedia.org/property/>

SELECT ?model WHERE {
  <http://dbpedia.org/resource/TDMSci> dbo:basedOn ?model .
  OPTIONAL { ?model dbp:tdp ?tdp } .
  OPTIONAL { ?model dbp:bronzeOn ?bronzeOn } .
  OPTIONAL { ?model dbp:cteam ?cteam } .
  OPTIONAL { ?model dbp:dtxsid ?dtxsid } .
  OPTIONAL { ?model dbp:goldOn ?goldOn } .
  OPTIONAL { ?model dbp:silverOn ?silverOn } .
  OPTIONAL { ?model dbp:tmrca ?tmrca } .
  OPTIONAL { ?model dbp:drivesOn ?drivesOn } .
  OPTIONAL { ?model dbp:tdsrank ?tdsrank } .
}
